name: Cain
bio:
Cain is the firstborn son of Adam and Eve, the first person born in Scripture, and the perpetrator of history's first murder. A tiller of the ground, his offering to the LORD was not accepted for lacking sincerity, and in jealous anger he lured his brother Abel into a field and killed him (Genesis 4:1-8).

When the LORD questioned him, Cain retorted, "Am I my brother's keeper?" God cursed him to be a restless wanderer on the earth, yet still showed him mercy by placing a mark on him to protect him from vengeance (Genesis 4:9-15). Cain then left the LORD's presence to dwell in the land of Nod, east of Eden, and built a city there. His story stands as a warning in Scripture of how jealousy, anger, and a refusal to repent lead to devastating consequences.
